The '''2006–07 [[Super League Greece]]''' was the 71st season of the highest [[Association football|football]] league of Greece and the inaugural under the name ''Super League''. The season began on 19 August 2006 and ended on 13 May 2007. [[Olympiacos F.C.|Olympiacos]] clinched the title on 22 April with their victory over [[A.O. Kerkyra|Kerkyra]], for their third straight title and 10th in the last 11 years.

For the next season, [[Ionikos F.C.|Ionikos]], [[A.O. Kerkyra|Kerkyra]] and [[Egaleo F.C.|Egaleo]] have been relegated to [[Football League (Greece)|B' Ethniki]] given that they have finished in the lowest three spots of the table. [[Asteras Tripolis F.C.|Asteras Tripolis]], [[Levadiakos F.C.|Levadiakos]] and [[Veria F.C.|Veria]] was promoted from [[2006–07 Beta Ethniki|B' Ethniki]] for 2007–08.
